name: backend
description: Backend de Autenticación con Node.js y PostgreSQL

scripts.migrate: cross-env NODE_ENV=development sequelize-cli db:migrate --config config/config.cjs --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders --models-path models
scripts.seed: cross-env NODE_ENV=development sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config config/config.cjs --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders --models-path models
